row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (priced by Monthly Active Users)
row.evidence: Braze's pricing page lists "Enhanced security features and user provisioning" as what Braze Select adds over Braze Go, and the provisioning docs say "SCIM provisioning availability depends on your platform edition."
row.notes: New row. Braze sells four Platform Editions (Braze Go, Select, Pro, Enterprise), all quote-based and priced by Monthly Active Users plus message credits, so no per-user prices. User provisioning first appears on Braze Select, the second edition, so SCIM sits above the entry edition and behind Contact Sales (gated). The pricing page lists SAML SSO in every tier; the older SSO doc says Pro and Enterprise only (see conflicts). SCIM options: a custom SCIM 2.0 API (bearer token, X-Request-Origin header, optional IP allowlist; POST/GET/PUT/DELETE on /scim/v2/Users, no PATCH and no Groups endpoint documented) or Okta / Entra ID integrations (early access) that create and delete users and push groups for group-to-custom-role mapping (early access). Only one SCIM integration per company. Deprovisioning permanently deletes the dashboard user. SAML JIT (IdP-initiated only, enabled by Braze) is also available. The Braze REST API manages end-customer profiles, not dashboard users; the only dashboard-user API is SCIM.

plans.name: Braze Go
plans.notes: Core features; SSO listed under features included in every tier. User provisioning is first listed on Braze Select.

plans.name: Braze Pro
plans.notes: Everything in Braze Select plus expanded dashboard user group administration.

auth.token_source: Settings > Company Settings > Admin Settings > SCIM Provisioning > Configure SCIM integration > Generate SCIM token
auth.notes: Requests also need an X-Request-Origin header matching the configured service origin; optional IP allowlist. Token shown once.

endpoints.notes: Custom SCIM API documents only /scim/v2/Users. The Okta/Entra integrations sync groups over SCIM /Groups, but no Groups endpoint is documented for the custom API.

operations.notes: Group push and membership only through the Okta / Entra integrations with SCIM group role mapping (early access).

filtering.notes: Exact match with eq on userName only.

custom.how: Braze-specific top-level 'permissions' object (companyPermissions, roles, appGroup workspace permissions, permission sets, teams); read-only createdAt and lastSignInAt

roles.how: permissions object on the user (company, workspace, team permissions and custom roles by roleName/roleId); with Okta/Entra, IdP groups map to custom roles (early access)

rate_limits.text: 20,000 requests per day per company, shared across the /scim/v2/Users endpoints.

limitations.text: Only one SCIM integration per company; with the Okta or Entra ID integration the custom SCIM API endpoints cannot be used.
Okta and Entra ID SCIM integrations are in early access.
userName (email) cannot be changed over SCIM.
Users created manually before SCIM are not converted to IdP-managed users.
Legacy SCIM permission values stop being accepted in December 2026.

scim.notes: Edition gate from the pricing page ('user provisioning' on Braze Select); docs only say availability depends on platform edition.

audit_log_api.notes: Security events are a dashboard report download; no audit-log API found.

user_api.notes: The Braze REST API manages end-customer profiles. For dashboard users the docs point to SCIM and a Security Event report download (no list-users API). 'false' is by absence.

okta.notes: OIN page ticks SAML and SWA only. Braze's docs describe enabling SCIM on the Braze Okta app or a custom app with Braze's SCIM endpoint (early access).

entra.notes: Gallery tutorial covers SSO only; Braze's SCIM guide uses a non-gallery Entra app (early access).

onelogin.notes: Braze documents OneLogin SAML SSO; no OneLogin SCIM guide.

fallbacks.notes: JIT is IdP-initiated only and must be enabled by Braze.
